title: Component 4 hypothesis-generation output
description: Pre-injection prediction schema for the Component 4 hypothesis-generation study (analysis/PREREGISTRATION.md). One object per (model, candidate, sample). run-hypothesis-generation.py validates responses against this file by hand (required keys, throughput_direction enum, degraded_services drawn from services enum, weakness_signal_present boolean) rather than depending on an external jsonschema package, but the file itself is the single source of truth for the enums both the prompt and the validator use.

throughput_direction.description: Predicted direction of aggregate request throughput during the fault window relative to the steady-state baseline.

degraded_services.description: Services predicted to have p99 latency exceed 3x their steady-state baseline during the fault window. Empty list if none are predicted to.

weakness_signal_present.description: Predicted: will at least one resilience-weakness signal (error_rate > 5%, any service p99 > 3x baseline, recovery_time > 60s, pod_restarts > 0) fire during this injection?

rationale.description: One to three sentences explaining the prediction.
